capabilities.name: Ethereum Address Validation
capabilities.description: Validate an Ethereum address. Checks 0x-prefixed 40-hex format and EIP-55 mixed-case checksum to catch single-character typos. Returns checksummed (canonical) form. Pure algorithmic — fast and cheap.

capabilities.name: GitHub User Profile
capabilities.description: Fetch a GitHub user's profile, stats, and recent repositories. Returns followers, repos, bio, and activity.

capabilities.name: JWT Decode
capabilities.description: Decode a JWT token without verification. Returns header, payload, claims, expiry status, and time until expiry. Algorithmic.

capabilities.name: Risk Narrative Generator
capabilities.description: Generates a plain-language risk narrative from structured check results. Designed for non-technical users reviewing AI agent output. Supports KYB and invoice fraud contexts.

context.description: Context for the risk assessment (kyb or invoice_fraud)

check_results.description: Structured check results from upstream capabilities

capabilities.name: French Insolvency Check
capabilities.description: Check a French company for formal insolvency proceedings (redressement or liquidation judiciaire) via BODACC, the official French legal gazette. Search by SIREN or company name. Returns judgment dates, court, and nature.

task.description: Free-text alias — SIREN or company name

company_name.description: French company name to search for (alternative to SIREN)

capabilities.name: Japanese Company Data
capabilities.description: Look up Japanese company data from the National Tax Agency corporate number system. Accepts 13-digit corporate number or fuzzy company name.

capabilities.name: Email Validation
capabilities.description: Validate an email address: RFC 5322 syntax, MX records, 5,361 disposable domain detection, role-based address detection (35 patterns), free provider detection, and typo suggestion for common providers (gmial.com ? gmail.com). Returns deliverability assessment with per-check breakdown.

capabilities.name: Czech Bank Account Validator
capabilities.description: Validate Czech bank account in domestic BBAN format '[prefix-]account/bank_code' using mod-11 weighted checksums on prefix and account parts.

account.description: Czech bank account in format '[prefix-]account/bank_code' (e.g. '19-2000145399/0800' or '123456/0100')

capabilities.name: Credit Score Band
capabilities.description: Convert and interpret credit scores between different scoring systems. Maps FICO, VantageScore, Experian, Equifax scores to universal risk bands with percentile estimates.

system.description: Scoring system: fico, vantagescore, experian, equifax (default: fico)

capabilities.name: SEPA XML Validate
capabilities.description: Validate SEPA XML files (pain.001 credit transfer, pain.008 direct debit). Checks structure, IBANs, BICs, amounts, transaction counts.

capabilities.name: Token Security Check
capabilities.description: Analyze a token contract for security risks: honeypot detection, sell tax, hidden ownership, mint functions, proxy status, and holder distribution. Uses GoPlus Security covering 30+ blockchains and 10M+ tokens.

capabilities.name: Markdown to HTML
capabilities.description: Convert markdown to styled HTML with inline CSS. Supports light, dark, and plain themes. Algorithmic — instant.

capabilities.name: SSL Certificate Check
capabilities.description: Check a domain's SSL/TLS certificate. Returns issuer, validity dates, days until expiry, protocol version, cipher, and SAN entries.

capabilities.name: IBAN Validation
capabilities.description: Validate an IBAN number. Checks format, length, and mod-97 checksum. Extracts country code, bank identifier, and branch code. Pure algorithmic — fast and cheap.

capabilities.name: JSON Repair
capabilities.description: Repair broken JSON: trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, truncated, comments, mixed with markdown. Returns valid JSON.

capabilities.name: Unit Convert
capabilities.description: Convert between units: length, weight, volume, temperature, area, speed, data storage. Algorithmic — instant.

capabilities.name: PII Redaction
capabilities.description: Detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII) from text. Identifies names, emails, phone numbers, national ID numbers (Swedish personnummer, Finnish henkilötunnus, etc.), addresses, and more.

capabilities.name: Charity Lookup UK
capabilities.description: Look up UK charities via the Charity Commission API. Search by registration number or name. Returns status, income, activities.

capabilities.name: Meta Extract
capabilities.description: Extract all metadata from a URL: Open Graph, Twitter cards, JSON-LD, favicon, canonical URL, RSS feeds, robots directives.

capabilities.name: Food Safety Rating UK
capabilities.description: Look up UK food hygiene ratings via the FSA API. Search by business name and optional location. Returns ratings, scores, addresses.

capabilities.name: Irish Company Data
capabilities.description: Look up Irish company data from the Companies Registration Office (CRO) Open Data Portal. Accepts CRO number (5-6 digits) or fuzzy company name. Returns name, status, type, address, registration date, annual return dates, NACE code, and Eircode.

task.description: Free-text input — first matching CRO number or company name is used

company_name.description: Irish company name (fuzzy match)

capabilities.name: SERP Analyze
capabilities.description: Analyze Google search results for a keyword. Returns organic results, featured snippet, People Also Ask, SERP features.

country.description: Market to analyse the SERP for, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (SE), alpha-3 code (SWE), numeric code (752), or exact country name (Sweden). "UK" is accepted as an alias for GB. Unrecognised values are rejected before the search runs rather than silently ignored. Sent to Google as the gl parameter. Defaults to "us".

language.description: Language for results, as an ISO 639-1 code ("en"), optionally with a region ("pt-BR"). Validated for shape and rejected before the search runs if malformed, rather than silently ignored. Defaults to "en".

capabilities.name: Stock Quote
capabilities.description: Get real-time stock quote data for any publicly traded company. Accepts ticker symbols (e.g. AAPL, VOLV-B.ST). Returns price, change, volume, market state.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, TSLA, VOLV-B.ST)

capabilities.name: Czech IČO Validator
capabilities.description: Validate Czech IČO (company identifier) format and mod-11 checksum. Pure algorithmic — no external calls.

ico.description: Czech IČO (1-8 digits; will be left-padded to 8)

capabilities.name: Age Verify
capabilities.description: Verify if a person meets a minimum age requirement based on their date of birth. Returns exact age, whether the threshold is met, and days until the threshold (if not met). Accounts for leap years.

capabilities.name: Regex Generate
capabilities.description: Describe what you want to match in natural language, get a tested regex back. Optionally provide test strings for validation.

description.description: What to match in natural language

capabilities.name: Workflow Security Audit
capabilities.description: Audit GitHub Actions workflow YAML for supply chain security risks. Checks action pinning (SHA vs mutable tags), permission scopes, secret exposure, trusted publishers, and dangerous trigger patterns like pull_request_target. Pure static analysis, no external API calls.

capabilities.name: Stablecoin Flow Check
capabilities.description: Check stablecoin supply and flows. Query by chain (stablecoin supply on Ethereum, Base, etc.), by stablecoin (USDC market cap and circulation), or get the overall market summary. Data from DeFi Llama.

capabilities.name: Norwegian Bankruptcy Check
capabilities.description: Check Norwegian entity bankruptcy and dissolution status via Brønnøysundregistrene Enhetsregisteret. Returns structured signals: has_bankruptcy_filing, bankruptcy_date, is_under_dissolution, is_under_compulsory_dissolution, plus official registry annotations. NLOD 2.0 license.

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organization number (with or without spaces). Canonical input.

company_name.description: Optional fallback input — Norwegian company name to search Brønnøysundregistrene if no org number is known.

capabilities.name: Google Search
capabilities.description: Perform a Google search and return structured results. Returns title, URL, snippet, position for each result.

country.description: Country to scope results to, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (MX), alpha-3 code (MEX), numeric code (484), or exact country name (Mexico). "UK" is accepted as an alias for GB. Unrecognised values are rejected before the search runs rather than silently ignored. Omit for unscoped global results.

language.description: Language for results, as an ISO 639-1 code ("en"), optionally with a region ("pt-BR"). Validated for shape and rejected before the search runs if malformed, rather than silently ignored. Omit for Google's default.

capabilities.name: Marketplace Fee Calculate
capabilities.description: Calculate seller fees for Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify. Returns total fees, net revenue, fee breakdown.

capabilities.name: WHOIS Lookup
capabilities.description: Perform a WHOIS lookup for a domain. Returns registrar, creation date, expiry date, name servers, registrant info, and raw WHOIS data.

capabilities.name: Product Reviews Extract
capabilities.description: Extract product reviews from a product or review page. Returns rating distribution, pros/cons, sentiment. Trustpilot is not supported (their ToS forbids automated access).

url.description: Product or review page URL. Sites whose Terms of Service forbid automated access (Trustpilot, Glassdoor, LinkedIn) are rejected without being fetched.

capabilities.name: Dependency Audit
capabilities.description: Audit npm or Python dependencies. Checks each package against registry for latest version, deprecation, vulnerabilities. Verifiable against actual registries.

capabilities.name: cURL to Code
capabilities.description: Convert a curl command to equivalent code in TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, or PHP.

capabilities.name: Keyword Suggest
capabilities.description: Get keyword suggestions from Google Autocomplete. Returns suggestions, questions, comparisons, long-tail keywords.

capabilities.name: ENS Reverse Lookup
capabilities.description: Look up the primary ENS name for a wallet address. Includes forward verification to confirm the name actually points back to the address. Returns null if no ENS name is set.

capabilities.name: Landing Page Roast
capabilities.description: AI conversion expert analyzes any landing page. Returns overall score, headline effectiveness, CTA clarity, value proposition, trust signals, issues, and suggestions.

capabilities.name: ISO Country Lookup
capabilities.description: Look up any country by name, ISO code (alpha-2/3/numeric). Returns region, capital, currency, EU/Schengen/Eurozone membership.

query.description: Country name, alpha-2, alpha-3, or numeric code

capabilities.name: Competitor Compare
capabilities.description: Compare two company websites. Analyzes positioning, pricing model, features, target audience, trust signals, content strategy. Returns structured comparison + strategic analysis.

capabilities.name: PR Description Generate
capabilities.description: Generate pull request descriptions from diffs or commit logs. Returns title, summary, changes list, testing steps.

capabilities.name: Finnish Company Data
capabilities.description: Look up Finnish company data from PRH (Patent and Registration Office). Accepts Business ID (e.g. 0112038-9) or fuzzy company name.

task.description: Free-text alias — business ID or company name

query.description: Free-text alias — business ID or company name

company_name.description: Finnish company name (resolved via scored PRH search)

capabilities.name: Test Case Generate
capabilities.description: Generate test cases from a function description or signature. Includes happy path, edge cases, boundary tests, and error cases.

capabilities.name: JSDoc Generate
capabilities.description: Add JSDoc comments to JavaScript/TypeScript functions and classes. Infers param types, return types, and throws.

capabilities.name: README Generate
capabilities.description: Generate comprehensive README.md from project description. Includes installation, usage, API docs, contributing sections.

capabilities.name: Name Parse
capabilities.description: Parse a full name into components: first, middle, last, prefix, suffix, nickname. Handles 'Dr. Karl-Johan von Lindström III' correctly.

capabilities.name: LLM Output Validate
capabilities.description: Validate and auto-repair LLM output. Parse JSON, validate against schema, attempt fixes for common LLM mistakes. Algorithmic — no LLM needed.

capabilities.name: IBAN to Bank
capabilities.description: Extract bank name and branch information from an IBAN. Returns bank name, BIC/SWIFT code, branch, and country. Pure algorithmic — uses bank code lookup tables.

capabilities.name: Code Convert
capabilities.description: Convert code between programming languages. Uses idiomatic patterns for the target language. Supports all major languages.

capabilities.name: API Docs Generate
capabilities.description: Generate markdown API documentation from an OpenAPI spec or natural language description. Returns documentation with parameters, examples, error codes.

capabilities.name: Pricing Page Extract
capabilities.description: Extract structured pricing data from any SaaS pricing page. Returns plan names, prices, features per plan, billing periods, trial/guarantee info.

capabilities.name: GitHub Repo Compare
capabilities.description: Compare two GitHub repositories side-by-side: stars, forks, activity, language, topics, license. Returns detailed comparison.

capabilities.name: Address Geocode
capabilities.description: Convert an address to geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude). Also returns structured address components and bounding box via OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

address.description: Address or place name to geocode

capabilities.name: HS Code Lookup
capabilities.description: AI-suggested HS commodity codes for a product description, with alternatives and confidence. Not an official customs classification.

capabilities.name: Barcode Lookup
capabilities.description: Look up product information by UPC/EAN barcode. Uses Open Food Facts and UPC ItemDB. Returns product name, brand, nutrition, images.

capabilities.name: Email Draft
capabilities.description: Draft a professional email. Specify context, intent (cold outreach/follow-up/apology/etc), and tone. Returns subject line options, body, and key phrases.

capabilities.name: Error Explain
capabilities.description: Explain an error message or stack trace in plain English. Identifies root cause, suggests fixes with code examples.

capabilities.name: API Mock Response
capabilities.description: Generate a realistic mock API response with proper headers, status codes, and schema-matching body data.

capabilities.name: Brand Mention Search
capabilities.description: Search Google for brand mentions. Returns URLs, titles, snippets, sentiment, and source type. Every result is a clickable, verifiable URL.

capabilities.name: Resume Parse
capabilities.description: Extract structured data from a CV/resume. Accepts PDF URL, base64, or text. Returns name, contact, experience, education, skills, certifications.

capabilities.name: Ticker Lookup
capabilities.description: Find stock ticker symbols by company name. Returns matches with symbol, exchange, and type.
